content.label: Contains
content.help: Several words: all of them must appear. Between "quotes": the exact phrase.

stateDisplay.idleMessage: Start typing to find files and folders. Use the filters for type, content or a folder to look in.
stateDisplay.emptyMessage: Try adjusting your keywords or filters.

columns.sizeIncomplete: Lower bound: part of this folder is unreadable or excluded from the index.

sorting.disabled: Sorting is disabled. Too many results ({{limit}}+) may impact performance. You can adjust the threshold in Preferences.
sorting.disabledFolderSizes: Sorting by size is unavailable: completing folder totals means walking every result on disk. Available up to {{limit}} results, adjustable in Preferences.

empty.title: No recent file events yet.
empty.hint: Keep working and check back for updates.

rescan.disabledHint: Rescan becomes available once Cardinal is ready.
rescan.errorCountSuffix: {{formatted}} filesystem errors have occurred, rescan is suggested.

fullDiskAccess.title: Full Disk Access Required
fullDiskAccess.description: Cardinal needs macOS Full Disk Access to index and monitor files across your system. Please enable Full Disk Access for Cardinal in System Settings.

steps.one: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access.
steps.two: Click the lock to make changes and enable Cardinal.
steps.three: When prompted, allow macOS to restart Cardinal.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.heading: Make Cardinal yours
preferences.subtitle: Adjust appearance and language to your liking.
preferences.themeHint: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.

deepSortingLimit.label: Sorting limit with folder walk
deepSortingLimit.hint: Ordering by size waits for every folder in the result set to be walked, so it has its own, lower limit.

foldersFirst.label: Folders on top
foldersFirst.hint: Group folders ahead of files, whichever column is sorting.

folderSizes.label: Show folder sizes
folderSizes.hint: Adds up what each visible folder holds. A total that cannot be complete is marked with +.
folderSizes.needsColumn: Needs the Size column, which is hidden.

deepFolderSizes.label: Include excluded folders in the total
deepFolderSizes.warning: ⚠︎ Walks the caches and cloud folders left out of the index. It can slow the system down and use more battery. The walk runs at the lowest priority and yields to everything else.

watchRoot.label: Monitor root path
watchRoot.help: Changing this will rebuild the index for the new directory.

errors.absolute: Please enter an absolute path starting with '/' or '~'.

watchRoot.title: Choose monitor root path
watchRoot.description: Cardinal will index and monitor files under this directory. You can change it later in Preferences.

ignorePaths.label: Ignore paths
ignorePaths.help: One path per line; ignored paths are skipped during indexing.

errors.absolute: Each path must start with '/' or '~'.

includePaths.label: Include paths
includePaths.help: One path per line; included paths stay indexed even under an ignored parent.

errors.absolute: Each path must start with '/' or '~'.

failed.title: Could not check for updates
failed.body: Cardinal could not reach GitHub. Check your connection, or open the releases page in your browser.

mounted.title: Cardinal {{latest}} is ready
mounted.body: Drag the new version onto the Applications folder.

downloadFailed.title: Download failed
downloadFailed.body: Cardinal could not download the update. You can get it from the releases page instead.
